newsitem.title: EGYPT: U.S. carrier Enterprise enters Gulf of Suez.
newsitem.headline: U.S. carrier Enterprise enters Gulf of Suez.

text.p: The U.S. aircraft carrier Enterprise steamed into the Red Sea on Sunday en route to join U.S. forces in the Gulf, sources at the Suez Canal Authority said.
The carrier, with about 75 warplanes aboard, entered the canal in the early hours and passed the town of Suez in the afternoon, they said.
It has steamed from the Adriatic to join the U.S. aircraft carrier Carl Vinson and the other forces assembled in the Gulf for possible action against Iraqi targets.

The Enterprise planes include F-14 fighters recently modified to carry laser-guided bombs. They strengthen a force that includes four B-52 bombers now on the Indian Ocean island of Diego Garcia and eight Stealth fighters sent to Kuwait.
